sources.snippet: Tashkeel-350M-v2 is a model specifically designed for phonetic notation of Arabic text, with 350 million parameters. This model is based on the ibm-granite/granite-4.-h-350m model and is fine-tuned on the Misraj/Sadeed_Tashkeela dataset.
